import json,hashlib,re,datetime
from pathlib import Path
b=Path('documents/400_PGPT/470_PMO/500_SV計画整備_20261104')

body=guard.read_text();held=set(re.findall(r'"(dev/codex/schubert/nk/[^"]+)"',body))
assert len(held)==4
def gate(reachable,complete,fixtureReviewed):
 if not isinstance(reachable,set) or type(complete) is not bool or type(fixtureReviewed) is not bool: raise ValueError('explicit operation proof required')
 if held&reachable:return 'HOLD_SCOPE_UNRESOLVED'
 if not complete or not fixtureReviewed:return 'PRECONDITIONS_UNPROVEN_NO_EXECUTION'
 return 'PT_DEFAULT_FOR_REVIEWED_OPERATION_ONLY'

for r in m['rows']:
 if r['module']!='schubert-nk-api' or r['evidenceStatus']!='PARTIAL':continue
 p=Path(r['path']);assert '/src/main/java/' in str(p)
 text=p.read_text();assert hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==r['sha256']
 direct='TemporaryInfrastructureException' in text
 rows.append(dict(path=str(p),sha256=r['sha256'],owner=r['owner'],oldCounters=r['counters'],directTemporaryInfrastructureReference=direct,operationDecision=gate({'dev/codex/schubert/nk/api/error/TemporaryInfrastructureException'} if direct else set(),False,False),reason='Known direct held-class reference; current exception/cleanup portion cannot be executed' if direct else 'No direct reference; transitive operations and other DB/ownership/crypto prerequisites remain individually unproven. Not global nonapplicability or execution permission.',requiredEvidence='Exact selected whole Test/callee paths and fixed fixture, class-level held intersection, source/owner/postconditions before execution',newAcceptance=False))
assert len(rows)==21 and sum(r['directTemporaryInfrastructureReference'] for r in rows)==6
vectors=0
for name in held:
 assert gate({name},True,True)=='HOLD_SCOPE_UNRESOLVED';vectors+=1
 assert gate({name},False,False)=='HOLD_SCOPE_UNRESOLVED';vectors+=1
for complete,reviewed in ((False,False),(False,True),(True,False)):
 assert gate(set(),complete,reviewed)=='PRECONDITIONS_UNPROVEN_NO_EXECUTION';vectors+=1
assert gate(set(),True,True)=='PT_DEFAULT_FOR_REVIEWED_OPERATION_ONLY';vectors+=1
for args in (([],True,True),(set(),1,True),(set(),True,None)):
 try:gate(*args)
 except ValueError:vectors+=1
 else:raise AssertionError('incomplete gate metadata accepted')

assert len(re.findall(r'@Test\s+void\s+projection\d+',draft.read_text()))==10
